text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the limited-time "Triple-Decker Colorful Ice Cream"...
I'm glad we could take it to go.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I bought it on impulse, but...
I wonder what it tastes like?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...*chew*, *munch*...
There's more food here than I expected...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! It's starting to melt from the bottom...!
*munch, munch, gulp*...!
"Still in Love ate so slowly that the ice cream melted, leaving her unable to finish it all..."
